title: Drilling program authoring and review
status: gate met - AC-1..AC-6 met: a program cannot be submitted with an incomplete section or an incomplete well design; the three design checks exist as 'not run' and never read as passed; the author cannot review their own program; a revision appends a version and leaves the approved one untouched; every depth and diameter carries its unit; and the total is the sum of the section costs. A failed check is recorded and does not block the submit, and a lost acknowledgement is retained for retry.

dataModel.decision: The module's DRILLING_PROGRAM is the funded company program: its schema marks an AFE id, an investment handoff id and the bounded original draft proof as required, and DrillingOperationService reads that row set by AFE. Writing a plan-stage program there was tried first and the framework refused it ('AFE_ID: The AFE_ID field is required', and the same for the handoff, the outcome revision and the draft proof), and inventing those ids would fabricate a funding reference. DEV-05 therefore owns a separate plan-stage program record in the same module.
tables: DEVELOPMENT_DRILLING_PROGRAM (PROGRAM_ID key, LINEAGE_ID, VERSION, COMPANY_ID, FDP_ID, FDP_BASELINE_ID, FIELD_ID, WELL_ID, DESIGN_ID, PROGRAM_NAME, DESCRIPTION_OBJECTIVE, STATE, PLANNED_MEASURED_DEPTH, PLANNED_TRUE_VERTICAL_DEPTH, DEPTH_OUOM, PLANNED_DURATION_DAYS, CURRENCY) - the plan-stage program; a revision appends a row with a higher VERSION and the same LINEAGE_ID

DRILLING_PROGRAM_SECTION (SECTION_ID key, PROGRAM_ID, SECTION_SEQ, SECTION_NAME, HOLE_SIZE + OUOM, TOP_MD, BOTTOM_MD, DEPTH_OUOM, CASING_OD + OUOM, MUD_WEIGHT + OUOM, DURATION_DAYS, COST, COST_CURRENCY) - the hole sections; CASING_PROGRAM remains the detailed casing record
DRILLING_PROGRAM_CHECK (CHECK_ID key, PROGRAM_ID, CHECK_NAME, STATUS, REFERENCE, NOTE, CHECKED_BY, CHECKED_AT) - three rows written at creation as NOT_RUN
DRILLING_PROGRAM_REVIEW (REVIEW_ID key, PROGRAM_ID, PROGRAM_VERSION, DECISION, COMMENTS, REVIEWER, REVIEWED_AT) - append-only review history
dataModel.registration: DrillingAndConstructionSetupModule registers the four types; --smoke now reports 366 entity types (up from 362).
dataModel.fundedRowSet: DRILLING_PROGRAM, CASING_PROGRAM, CEMENT_JOB, DRILLING_FLUID and DRILLING_BIT are untouched by this feature.

implementation.designGate: The submit reads the current DEV-03 design for the well and applies OgWellDesignService.ToWell(...).MissingItems (the DEV-03 rule, made public for this use), so an incomplete design blocks the submit with the same item names DEV-03 uses.
implementation.page: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop/Views/DrillingProgramPageView.cs (route 'drillingprogram': designed-well picker, program grid, header fields, hole-section grid and editor, checks panel, review panel, version history)
implementation.wiring: OgBootstrapper (IOgDrillingPrograms), OgApplication.DrillingPrograms, catalog 'drillingprogram' (OgModuleKeys.Development), OgPageFactory, en + ar labels; DEV-01's drilling-program link now resolves
implementation.tests: test/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.Tests/DrillingProgramTests.cs (10, no database) + DrillingProgramGatewayTests.cs (1 opt-in, real SQLite)

integration.database: SQLite with FIELD_DEVELOPMENT_PLAN, FDP_BASELINE, DEVELOPMENT_WELL_DESIGN, DEVELOPMENT_CASING_STRING, DEVELOPMENT_CASING_CHECK, DEVELOPMENT_DRILLING_PROGRAM, DRILLING_PROGRAM_SECTION, DRILLING_PROGRAM_CHECK and DRILLING_PROGRAM_REVIEW, seeded in DrillingProgramGatewayTests
integration.ac2_not_run: a newly created program has exactly three checks (HYDRAULICS, TORQUE_DRAG, CASING_DESIGN) and every one reports IsRun=false and StatusText 'not run'; recording HYDRAULICS as NOT_RUN again still leaves all three not run
integration.ac1_section: submitting with no section is refused with drill-program-section-required; a section with no duration is refused with drill-program-section-incomplete and the message names 'duration'
integration.ac6_total: two sections at 400,000 and 900,000 produce TotalCost 1,300,000 with TotalIsComplete true; a section without a cost produces a 'partial' total that says a section has no cost
integration.checks: HYDRAULICS recorded PASS with reference 'eng-hydraulics' reads as passed while TORQUE_DRAG stays not run; TORQUE_DRAG recorded FAIL sets AnyCheckFailed and the submit still succeeds (a failed check is recorded, not blocking)
integration.ac3_author: the author reviewing their own submitted program is refused with drill-program-author-cannot-approve; the reviewer 'reviewer' then approves and one review row is recorded
integration.ac4_revision: ReviseAsync writes version 2 in state DRAFT with the same LINEAGE_ID and two copied sections; its checks are all NOT_RUN; the version history still shows version 1 as APPROVED with its two sections and its passed hydraulic check
integration.designGate: a program created for the design with no casing outline is refused at submit with drill-program-design-incomplete, and the message names 'Casing scheme' - DEV-03's own wording
integration.lost_ack: a SQLite trigger made the submit update fail: the submit was refused and retained in Pending, the version was still DRAFT on re-read, and after the trigger was dropped the retry submitted the same program

gates.AC-1 A program cannot be submitted with: pass - SubmissionGaps names 'no hole section is recorded' and each incomplete section with its missing fields; the submit refuses with section-required or section-incomplete and writes nothing.
gates.AC-2 Design checks that were not run are: pass - the three checks are written as NOT_RUN at creation and AnyCheckFailed/StatusText never turn NOT_RUN into a pass; the gateway test proves a fresh program has no run check.
gates.AC-3 The author cannot approve: pass - ReviewAsync compares the program's ROW_CREATED_BY with the reviewer and refuses with drill-program-author-cannot-approve; the gateway test proves the refusal and that another reviewer can approve.
gates.AC-4 A revision never mutates the approv: pass - ReviseAsync appends a new row with VERSION+1 and the same LINEAGE_ID, copying sections and resetting checks; the version history reads version 1 back as APPROVED with its own sections and check results.
gates.AC-5 Depths and diameters always carry u: pass - the program header requires a depth unit when a depth is recorded, and a section requires its hole/depth/casing/mud units whenever the value is present; each is a named refusal (drill-program-unit-required / drill-program-depth-unit-required).
gates.AC-6 Total cost equals the sum of sectio: pass - TotalCost is Sections.Sum(Cost) and TotalIsComplete requires a cost on every section; a cost needs the program's currency, so the sum is never taken across currencies.

limits: The three design checks are recorded, not computed: hydraulics, torque & drag and casing design belong to ENG-07, ENG-08 and ENG-02, which are not built. The panel shows 'not run' with a reference field for the detailed result and never fabricates a pass.

The plan-stage program is not copied into the funded DRILLING_PROGRAM row set, and this screen does not read that row set: the company program is created from the plan by the module's own funding flow once the AFE and handoff exist.
A failed check is recorded and shown to the reviewer but does not block the submit, exactly as the feature doc's state table says; blocking on failures is a policy this document does not give.
Section sequence numbers are authored; a gap in the sequence is allowed (the grid orders by the number), and the checks that intervals abut or overlap are not made.
Trajectory stations, hydraulics and torque & drag results are not displayed; their screens are STG-16 and are not built.
The feature doc's per-command permissions (drilling.program.write / .submit / .approve) are not enforced: the app gates pages, not commands.
The four new tables (and the module's entity list) need the DRILLING_EXECUTION module applied again on an existing database.
